settings.siteTitle: Jeon Hyun Young — Game Designer Portfolio
settings.intro:
I design the moments when a player's choice starts to matter.
A game designer focused on systems and level design, finding the balance between numbers and feelings.

about.heading: About Me
about.bio:
I want to be a designer who reads play data and players' feelings together.
I have worked on combat and economy systems, balancing and puzzle level design, and I like to test ideas quickly with documents and prototypes.

projects.title: Ashen Tide
projects.subtitle: Combat system design
projects.summary: An action RPG combat system built around parrying and stamina risk
projects.description:
The goal was the fun of reading and reacting in short, rhythmic exchanges.
I set DPS, stamina and parry windows for each weapon in data tables, and over three playtests raised the parry success rate from 21% to 47%.

projects.title: Hollow Market
projects.subtitle: Economy system and balancing
projects.summary: Economy design for a shop game where prices move with supply, demand and events
projects.description: I designed the pricing formula and simulated gold inflow and outflow over 30 in-game days to keep inflation in check.

projects.title: Lumen Trail
projects.subtitle: Puzzle level design
projects.summary: Puzzle levels built on a teach, test, twist structure
projects.description: Each chapter introduces exactly one new rule. I then tuned the difficulty curve with clear-time and hint-usage data.
